🛠️ Aim Assist 1.0.1 fixes loading on the latest Skyrim update.

## ✨ What's new in 1.0.1
- 🆕 **Skyrim 1.7.x support:** 1.0 was refused by SKSE on 1.7.x ("address library needs to be updated"). It's now built on a current CommonLibSSE-NG that understands the new Address Library format.
- 🎮 **Correct look hook on 1.7.x:** the update moved the game's right-stick handler, so the plugin now hooks the right spot for whichever version you run.
- 🔧 **Input passthrough fix:** the hook now forwards all of the game's input data, instead of dropping one argument.

---

## 🎮 What Aim Assist does
Aim Assist is an SKSE plugin that adds controller aim assist to Skyrim SE/AE without touching mouse and keyboard.
- 🐢 **Friction:** slows your turning while a target sits inside the aim cone.
- 🧲 **Magnetism:** nudges the crosshair toward the target's chest.
- 🎯 **Smart targeting:** hostile only, line of sight, max distance and cone size are all adjustable.
- 🖱️ **Controller only:** it hooks the right-stick look handler, so mouse aiming is never affected.
- 🛠️ **Tunable:** MCM menu, plus `AimAssist.ini` for aim height, distance and invert options.

## 📜 Release history
- **1.0.1:** works on Skyrim 1.7.x (the latest update), plus a fix to how the look hook passes input to the game.
- **1.0:** first release, with friction, magnetism and an MCM menu.

## 📲 Install
Needs Skyrim SE/AE 1.5.97, 1.6.x or 1.7.x, [SKSE64](https://skse.silverlock.org/) and [Address Library](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/32444) (the all-in-one file for your game version). The MCM menu also needs [SkyUI](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/12604) and [MCM Helper](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/53000).
1. Download `AimAssist-1.0.1.zip` below.
2. Drag it onto the Vortex mods page, then install and enable it.
3. Launch through `skse64_loader.exe`. The log at `Documents/My Games/Skyrim Special Edition/SKSE/AimAssist.log` should say "Look handler hooked".

Already have 1.0? Install 1.0.1 over it in Vortex and choose Replace. If it crashes at launch, please open an issue and attach the log.
